Tom / Emily —

Thanks for the quick feedback. Answers below and attached artifacts: 

- Marketplace: We are listed on AWS Marketplace (seller ID: redwood-inference) for our hosted API; I'll send the public listing link in a follow-up if you want to procure via marketplace. If Marketplace isn't desired, we can absolutely accept a standard PO to Redwood Inference, Inc. (billing contact billing@redwood.com).

- Billing / Terms: We support PO / net-30 for enterprise customers. We can also accept card for smaller pilots. If you'll go the PO route please share Acme's PO template and target PO date.

- SOC 2 & DPA: Attached is our SOC 2 report (redwood_soc2_report_q2_2027.pdf) and our standard DPA (standard_dpa_v2.docx). High level answers to your specific asks:
   • SOC 2 scope: infrastructure + platform controls for hosted API (AWS), third-party vendor management, access controls.
   • Log retention: standard production logs are retained for 90 days; audit logs (access, admin actions) retained for 365 days. If you need extended retention we can discuss an enterprise add-on.
   • DPA: we provide a standard DPA; we're open to limited edits but prefer to use our template to avoid extended redlines. If you need a rider for specific clauses, we can route to legal.

- Security questionnaire dependencies: For questionnaire items that require evidence (e.g., vulnerability scan reports, pen test summaries), we can provide redacted artifacts or set up a security call.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Emily to confirm if Procurement wants marketplace vs PO path and share any PO template.
2) Acme to confirm PO timeline; Redwood will return final invoice and Docusign if needed.
3) Aditya / Dev to set up a brief technical/security call if the team wants deeper evidence (SOC 2 scope, KMS/tenant separation, SSO, logging).

Attachments: redwood_soc2_report_q2_2027.pdf (application/pdf), standard_dpa_v2.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

Happy to jump on a call — I'm free Thu 10:00–12:00 PT for a 20–30m sync if that helps.

Best,

Hi Tom / Emily —

Quick notes from the engineering/security side to support procurement: 

• SOC 2 scope: Confirming Marissa's note — SOC 2 Type II covers our hosted API running on AWS (us-east-1/us-west-2 depending on region), control examples include IAM, key management, vulnerability scanning, and secure release processes.
• Data storage & retention: Customer data used for inference is isolated per-tenant in logical namespaces; model weights are shared read-only. Logs: request logs retained 90 days; access/audit logs 365 days.
• KMS & encryption: All customer data at-rest is encrypted using KMS; customers can integrate with their own KMS via our Private deployment or via BYOK for enterprise plans.
• Marketplace: We are available on AWS Marketplace for hosted API subscriptions. Procurement via Marketplace will simplify billing.

If you want, I can join the procurement call to walk through any SSO/KMS questions and confirm you have the exact artifacts for your security checklist. Suggested times: Thu 10:30 or Fri 9:00 PT.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
